Retrieve incremental entity updates

Source: R/updates.R
brreg_updates.Rd

Query the brreg change data capture (CDC) endpoint for entities modified since a given instant. Each update carries a monotonically increasing update_id suitable for cursor-based pagination and deduplication.

Usage

brreg_updates(
  since = Sys.Date() - 1,
  size = 100,
  max_pages = 1L,
  include_changes = FALSE,
  type = c("enheter", "underenheter", "roller"),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

since

Date, POSIXct, or ISO 8601 string. Return updates at or after this instant. Defaults to yesterday (midnight UTC).

size

Integer. Number of updates per page (max 10000).

max_pages

Integer. Maximum pages to fetch. Default 1. Set higher to paginate through large result sets automatically.

include_changes

Logical. If TRUE, include field-level change details per update as a list-column of tibbles. Not available for type = "roller", whose feed carries no field patches; supplying TRUE there is an error.

type

One of "enheter", "underenheter", or "roller". The roller feed uses the CloudEvents format and reports only which entity's roles changed; fetch the new state with brreg_roles().

verbose

Logical. Print page-level progress.

Value

A tibble with columns: update_id (integer), org_nr, change_type, timestamp (POSIXct, UTC). If include_changes = TRUE, a list-column changes with tibbles of operation, field, path, new_value. An empty feed yields a zero-row tibble with the same typed columns.

Time handling

since is sent to the feed as a UTC instant. A POSIXct keeps its full precision; a Date is midnight UTC of that day; an ISO 8601 string ("2026-03-01" or "2026-03-01T14:00:00Z") is parsed as UTC. Timestamps in the result are POSIXct in the UTC time zone, whatever the session time zone.

Completeness

The feed is read page by page until a page is short, the feed is exhausted, or max_pages is reached. The result carries attributes complete (FALSE when max_pages stopped the read while the last page was full, or a later page failed), pages_fetched, and cursor (the last update_id read; pass update_id + 1 as the next cursor to resume). Stopping on max_pages signals a tidybrreg_warning_truncated; a failure after the first page signals a tidybrreg_warning_partial and returns the pages already read; a failure on the first page aborts with a tidybrreg_error_http.

Unknown members

Any member of an update object that the package does not model is passed through as a column named by its snake_case key, and the result carries attribute unknown_members plus a single tidybrreg_warning_unknown_member, so an upstream addition cannot vanish silently.

See also

brreg_update_fields() for a flat alternative, tidybrreg_conditions for the conditions signalled.

Other tidybrreg entity functions: brreg_children(), brreg_download(), brreg_entity(), brreg_konsern(), brreg_prokura(), brreg_regnskap(), brreg_roles(), brreg_roles_legal(), brreg_search(), brreg_signatur(), brreg_underenheter(), brreg_update_fields()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive() && curl::has_internet()
brreg_updates(since = Sys.Date() - 1, size = 10)

# Auto-paginate
brreg_updates(since = "2026-03-01", size = 10000, max_pages = 50,
              verbose = TRUE)
}
